bio-mar-01-c1.text: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution. Ocean Zones. WHOI Ocean Learning Hub.
bio-mar-01-c1.quote: Because water strongly absorbs light, sunlight penetrates only to depths of about 200 meters (656 feet).
bio-mar-01-c1.claim: The top ~200 m is the photic zone, where there's enough sunlight for photosynthesis.

bio-mar-01-c2.text: Field, C. B.; Behrenfeld, M. J.; Randerson, J. T.; Falkowski, P (1998). Primary Production of the Biosphere: Integrating Terrestrial and Oceanic Components. Science 281(5374): 237-240.
bio-mar-01-c2.quote: Integrating conceptually similar models of the growth of marine and terrestrial primary producers yielded an estimated global net primary production (NPP) of 104.9 petagrams of carbon per year, with roughly equal contributions from land and oceans.
bio-mar-01-c2.claim: Marine photosynthesis fixes ~50 Gt C/year, comparable to land photosynthesis.

bio-mar-01-c2.text: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution. Biological Carbon Pump: How the Ocean Stores CO2. WHOI Ocean Learning Hub.
bio-mar-01-c2.quote: where it can stay locked away for hundreds to thousands of years
bio-mar-01-c2.claim: The 'biological pump' carries some carbon to the deep ocean for centuries.
